payload.text: Final implementation: deterministic Three.js 0.186.1 scene using the native WebGPU renderer, 4x MSAA, ACES exposure 1, warm directional sun, ambient fill and shadow receivers. The authored villa has stucco walls with actual inset openings, framed windows, paneled door, supported tiled porch, separately curved terracotta roof tiles, ridge caps, chimney, gutters and lantern. Garden geometry includes fitted paving, beveled limestone boundary blocks, gate pillars, mailbox, branching olives, needle foliage cypresses, shrubs, lavender and pots. The curved asphalt road has curb ribbons and broken white markings. The blue hatchback has contoured body sections, wheel arch cutouts, glass panels, trim, mirrors, lamps, four tires and detailed metallic rims. All visible native mesh buffers and actual world instance matrices are returned through inspectGeometry. Three recorded previews ran successfully; the final build passed with no animation loop or application processes left running. Limitations: the vehicle and rolling distant terrain are stylized, without detailed interiors; the final roof/windshield join and small background refinements were built after the third preview. Vite reports only its bundle-size advisory.
